harnessSource.description: Where eng-harness-flow is loaded from (informational; the run loads it via --skill-source/--skill). Default: skills/eng-harness-flow.

theFlowSchema.description: Path to the the-flow flight-plan schema, passed to `harness flow create flight-plan --schema`. The-flow ships it with the skill; resolve at runtime from the installed skill base (e.g. <agent-harness-root>/skills/the-flow/references/flight-plan.schema.json). Left empty by default so the prompt derives it.
